display.purpose: The hero name only, two lines, second indented 0.62em.

title.purpose: Plate titles, ledger entries, job titles.

label.purpose: Wall-label lines, filters, nav and metadata; tabular numerals.

caption.purpose: Instrument Serif italic plate numbers, greeting, proof headings, quote and ribbon.

footer-display.purpose: Sora 200 footer title, link names and wordmark; same faces as the rest of the site.

shadows.name: floating-bar
shadows.purpose: Desktop nav bar, with backdrop-filter: blur(14px).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Frames drawing out, text rising, hover nudges, fills rising.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Wall-coloured sheet lifting off a plate; Plate I clip-path unveil.

motion.name: plate-frame-draw
motion.purpose: First beat of the plate hang.

motion.name: plate-sheet-lift
motion.value: ::after scaleY(1) to scaleY(0), 1.2s ease-in-out, .5s delay, origin top
motion.purpose: Second beat: a sheet in the wall colour (--wall) lifts off the picture.

motion.name: ledger-log-in
motion.value: tbody tr opacity 0 to 1 (.6s ease), translateY(6px) to 0 (.8s ease-out); first row at 1120ms, +70ms per row
motion.purpose: Third beat on document plates: once the sheet has lifted, the table rows are logged in one by one.

motion.name: plate-one-unveil
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0), 1.3s ease-in-out .2s; scale 1.1 to 1, 1.9s; mount line inset 0 to 22px, 1.4s at 1.1s
motion.purpose: Hero photo unveil, then its mount line settles in.

motion.name: fill-rise
motion.value: ::before scaleY(0) to scaleY(1), .5s ease-out, origin bottom
motion.purpose: Champagne fill on footer rows, job-more and back-to-top hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no .motion class; transitions off; ribbon static; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Everything shows at rest for visitors who ask for reduced motion or when script fails.

narrative.overview:
The site is a private gallery. Gira and his work hang as framed plates on alternating walls: deep navy ink rooms and ivory paper rooms. Every picture (the portrait, each role's redrawn working document, each project visual, the request-to-tasks example, the volunteering panel, the case-study cover) sits inside a 1px frame held off it by a mat gap, and is read through an engraved wall label beneath or beside it: an italic plate number, a title, then medium and year separated by middle dots. Corners are square throughout.

The register is quiet luxury: light Sora display type at very large sizes, a single champagne accent, thin rules instead of boxes, and generous wall space between plates. Lists read as ruled ledgers and catalogues rather than card grids. Motion is slow and exponential: a frame draws out to its mat, then a sheet the colour of the wall lifts off the picture.

The palette "Holst" and the four fonts are owner commitments and are kept as given. The system refuses the split hero over a stat strip and the grid of rounded cards with pill tags.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ink walls alternating with ivory paper rooms; no third surface.
1px frame drawn as an `outline` offset by the mat (14px) around every plate.
Square corners everywhere; circles only for small dots.
Wall labels: Instrument Serif italic plate number, Sora title, Manrope medium/year line with "·" separators.
Champagne is the only accent: frames, actions, numerals, diamond markers.
Ruled ledgers (hairline top and bottom rules) for catalogues, steps, courses and links.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Champagne is the only accent hue. It marks frames, actions and numerals; it never fills a large surface (beyond a button, the hover fill of a footer row, or the intro column wipe).

rules.name: The Two Walls Rule
rules.body: A section is either an ink wall or an ivory paper room. Navy is a raised plate or band on the dark side, not a third wall colour.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Sora display and headings stay at weight 200-300; weight comes from size, not boldness.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The footer speaks in the same faces as the rooms above (Sora display, Manrope text); the owner retired Archivo on 2026-11-19. Do not bring a footer-only face back.

rules.name: The Mat Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A plate is lifted by its frame and mat, never by a drop shadow. Shadows are reserved for elements that float over scrolling content.

dos: **Do** hang every picture as a plate: 1px frame as an outline at the 14px mat offset, square corners, a wall label with an italic plate number.
**Do** alternate ink walls and ivory paper rooms, using the champagne frame on dark and the ink frame on paper.
**Do** separate wall-label items with "·" in the frame colour, and mark list items with small rotated-square diamonds.
**Do** set numerals in tabular figures, in champagne on dark walls.
**Do** present collections as ruled ledgers with hairline rules.
**Do** keep Sora at weight 200-300 and let size carry hierarchy.
**Do** keep the footer in Sora and Manrope, like every other room.
donts: **Don't** round any corner; circles are only for small dots.
**Don't** use pill tags, icon tiles, or grids of rounded cards.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue; sage is a status colour, not an accent.
**Don't** lift plates with drop shadows; shadows are for floating bars and the toast only.
**Don't** build a split hero over a stat strip; highlights live in the wall label.
